test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 2 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: After melting three cubes of sides 6 cm, 8 cm and 10 cm, a big cube is made. Find the side of the new cube.
solution:
Given:

Edges of three cubes of metal are 6, 8, 10 cm respectively

Formula Used:

The volume of the cube = (Side)3

Calculation: 

The volume of cube 1 = (6)3 cm3

The volume of cube 2 = (8)3 cm3

The volume of cube 3 = (10)³ cm3 

⇒ Total volume = 216 + 512 + 1000 = 1728 cm3

The volume of new cube = 1728 cm3

⇒ 1728 = (SIde)3

⇒ Side = 3sqrt{12 times 12 times 12}

⇒ Side = 12 cm

∴ The edge of the new cube is 12 cm.

The correct option is 4 i.e. 12 cm
